step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory
step1_figure.description: A DSM circuit that senses the resistance of a memory cell (Rmbit) by balancing the current through it with charge pulses from a switched capacitor (Ccup). A clocked comparator with a built-in offset maintains the bitline voltage, and the output pulse density represents the sensed resistance.

Qcup.description: The amount of charge transferred from the cup capacitor to the bitline during one active clock cycle.

equation.explanation: Calculates the charge dumped into the bitline per pulse, assuming the capacitor charges to VDD and discharges to VREF + VTHP.
equation.assumptions: M4 source reaches VDD during precharge and discharges fully to VREF + VTHP during evaluation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 VDD of 1.8V, VREF of 0.5V, and PMOS Vth of ~0.42V.

Imbit.description: The average current flowing through the resistive memory cell.

equation.explanation: The current through the memory resistor is determined by the comparator's offset voltage divided by the resistance.
equation.assumptions: The DSM feedback loop successfully holds the average bitline voltage at VREF + Vos.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming an induced comparator offset Vos of ~50mV, Imbit = 50mV / 200kOhm = 0.25uA
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the actual offset voltage Vos generated by the mismatched input pair in the comparator.

dVbit.description: The maximum voltage ripple on the bitline when a charge pulse is dumped into it.

equation.explanation: The change in bitline voltage is proportional to the ratio of the cup capacitance to the bitline capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Charge is conserved and transferred instantaneously from Ccup to Cbit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly scales with Qcup and the inverse of Cbit.

Rsc.description: The equivalent resistance of the switched-capacitor circuit when enabled continuously.

equation.explanation: Models the switched capacitor as an equivalent resistor based on the clock frequency.
equation.assumptions: Complete settling of the capacitor voltage occurs in each clock phase.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by the passive component Ccup and the clock frequency.

M_over_N.description: The ratio of output pulses (M) to total clock cycles (N), representing the sensed resistance.

equation.explanation: The pulse density required to balance the current leaving through Rmbit with the charge arriving from Ccup.
equation.assumptions: The DSM is in lock and the average current from Ccup equals Imbit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the actual Vos and Qcup values in the simulation.

VREF_max.description: Maximum reference voltage to ensure M4 operates correctly and charge transfer can go to zero.

equation.explanation: Ensures that the PMOS transistor M4 has enough gate-source voltage to turn on and transfer charge.
equation.assumptions: Body effect is neglected or VTHP represents the effective threshold voltage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 VDD and typical PMOS threshold voltage.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the DSM sensing circuit's charge transfer, bitline ripple, memory current, and output pulse density.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DSM Sensing Circuit Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* Parameterize widths to induce a ~50mV offset in the comparator (W_xm10 > W_xm1)
.param W_xm1=1.0 L_xm1=0.15
.param W_xm2=2 L_xm2=0.15
.param W_xm3=2 L_xm3=0.15
.param W_xm4=2 L_xm4=0.15
.param W_xm5=1 L_xm5=0.15
.param W_xm6=1 L_xm6=0.15
.param W_xm7=2 L_xm7=0.15
.param W_xm8=1 L_xm8=0.15
.param W_xm9=1 L_xm9=0.15
.param W_xm10=1.2 L_xm10=0.15
.param W_xm11=1 L_xm11=0.15
.param W_xm12=1 L_xm12=0.15

* 100MHz Clocks (T=10ns)
Vclock clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 8n 100p 100p 1.8n 10n)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0n 100p 100p 3n 10n)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 4n 100p 100p 3n 10n)

* DUT
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm3 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N002 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 N003 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N001 0 1e-13
xm4 vbit VREF N004 N004 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
VREF VREF 0 500m
X_U1 vbit VREF N003 Out clock VDD 0 SUB_1
Cbit vbit 0 5e-13
R1 VREF vbit 200000.0

.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

.control
  tran 1n 2000n
  
  * Measure Vos (average vbit - VREF)
  meas tran vbit_avg avg v(vbit) from=1000n to=2000n
  let vos = vbit_avg - 0.5
  print vos
  
  * Measure Imbit (average current through R1)
  meas tran imbit_avg avg i(VREF) from=1000n to=2000n
  print imbit_avg
  
  * Measure dVbit (ripple)
  meas tran vbit_max max v(vbit) from=1500n to=1600n
  meas tran vbit_min min v(vbit) from=1500n to=1600n
  let dvbit = vbit_max - vbit_min
  print dvbit
  
  * Measure Qcup (charge per pulse)
  meas tran vn001_max max v(N001) from=1500n to=1520n
  meas tran vn001_min min v(N001) from=1500n to=1520n
  let qcup = (vn001_max - vn001_min) * 1e-13
  print qcup
  
  * Measure M/N ratio (pulse density)
  meas tran n003_avg avg v(N003) from=1000n to=2000n
  let m_over_n = 1 - (n003_avg / 1.8)
  print m_over_n
  
  quit
.endc
